purpose: Go-live commissioning checklist for Industry 4.0 deployment. All applicable items must pass (or be formally risk-accepted) before operations handover.

activities.activity: OFC termination testing and certification
prerequisites: All fiber optic cables pulled and terminated
OTDR / power meter available and calibrated
activities.procedure_required: Per-link OTDR certification per project cabling specification
activities.acceptance_criteria: All OFC links within loss budget; results recorded per link

activities.activity: Copper and fiber cable certification
prerequisites: All runs pulled, terminated, and labeled
activities.procedure_required: Cable certifier continuity, length, crosstalk, and loss per TIA/EIA standards
activities.acceptance_criteria: Every run certified and labeled to match as-built documentation

activities.activity: VLAN segmentation and OT/IT DMZ validation
prerequisites: Switches and firewalls installed and configured per solution architecture
VLAN and firewall rule set approved by ARB
activities.procedure_required: Segmentation test plan with deny-by-default verification per switch port and firewall rule
activities.safety_hold_point: OT network not yet connected to production — segmentation must be verified before connection
activities.acceptance_criteria: Deny-by-default confirmed; only explicitly permitted cross-zone traffic allowed; pen test passes

activities.activity: Time synchronization (PTP/NTP) validation
prerequisites: PTP grandmaster and NTP servers installed and configured
All time-sensitive devices configured with PTP/NTP client
activities.procedure_required: Time offset measurement at each time-sensitive device against GPS/GNSS reference
activities.acceptance_criteria: All time-sensitive devices within target accuracy tolerance (microseconds for PTP, milliseconds for NTP)

activities.activity: Edge gateway commissioning and protocol bridging validation
prerequisites: Edge gateway installed, powered, and network connected
PLC/SCADA/DCS southbound interfaces documented
activities.procedure_required: Per-gateway commissioning checklist: southbound protocol discovery → tag mapping → northbound OPC UA/MQTT publication → data receipt at historian
activities.safety_hold_point: Read-only data collection verified before any bidirectional connection is enabled
activities.acceptance_criteria: All mapped tags publishing to historian with correct values and metadata; no unexpected write operations

activities.activity: Sensor installation and data quality validation
prerequisites: Sensors mounted per specification and wired to gateway/I-O module
Edge gateway commissioned for the asset
activities.procedure_required: Per-sensor validation: raw value vs. reference measurement over full range → data platform receipt confirmation
activities.safety_hold_point: Sensor wiring confirmed; no unapproved wiring in hazardous area without permit
activities.acceptance_criteria: Sensor values within accuracy spec; data appearing in historian at expected rate; no alarms from sensor faults

activities.activity: Industrial wireless survey and signal validation
prerequisites: Wireless access points and clients installed per design
activities.procedure_required: Site survey tool walk-path across all wireless coverage zones; signal strength and packet loss measurement
activities.acceptance_criteria: RSSI ≥ -70 dBm and packet loss < 1% at all expected device locations; no coverage gaps in required zones

activities.activity: Historian / time-series data platform deployment and data ingestion validation
prerequisites: Historian platform installed and licensed
Edge gateways publishing data northbound
activities.procedure_required: Tag group import from edge gateway; verify data ingestion rate, completeness, and latency
activities.acceptance_criteria: All expected tags ingesting; latency < 5 s end-to-end; data completeness > 99% over 24-hour run

activities.activity: Control tower / OEE dashboard UAT
prerequisites: Historian data flowing for pilot line
OEE calculation engine deployed and configured
activities.procedure_required: User acceptance test script walk-through with plant operations and shift supervisors
activities.acceptance_criteria: OEE values match manual calculation on representative shift data; operators confirm dashboard usability

activities.activity: MES/QMS/WMS integration data flow validation
prerequisites: Connectors deployed between data platform and each source system
Data model mapping approved
activities.procedure_required: End-to-end trace order through MES → production → QMS test → data platform → dashboard
activities.safety_hold_point: None — integration is read-only from data platform to source systems
activities.acceptance_criteria: Order genealogy complete end-to-end; quality results linked to production run; traceability query completes within 5 s

activities.activity: Data quality enforcement rules validation
prerequisites: Data quality rules defined per asset class
Data platform configured to enforce rules
activities.procedure_required: Inject known-bad data (nulls, outliers, stale values) and verify rule firing and flagging
activities.acceptance_criteria: All test data quality violations detected, flagged, and alerted within 2 minutes

activities.activity: End-to-end traceability (module genealogy) validation
prerequisites: MES and QMS integrated
Data platform pipeline operational
activities.procedure_required: Trace a test lot from raw material receipt through production stages to final shipment using the traceability dashboard
activities.acceptance_criteria: Complete genealogy (material lots, process params, quality results, timestamps) available within 5 s query time

activities.activity: Computer vision model deployment and edge inference validation
prerequisites: Cameras installed and calibrated
Vision model trained and validated
Edge GPU commissioned
activities.procedure_required: Deploy model to edge GPU; run through test defect set at line speed; measure inference latency and detection rate
activities.safety_hold_point: Model output must not yet control any process — operator-in-the-loop only until closed-loop is validated separately
activities.acceptance_criteria: Inference latency within budget at full line speed; detection rate above threshold on reference defect set

activities.activity: Predictive maintenance model validation on live data
prerequisites: PdM model trained on historical data
Edge gateway streaming live vibration/temperature/current data
activities.procedure_required: Run PdM inference on live edge data stream; compare prediction vs actual maintenance events over 7-day period
activities.safety_hold_point: PdM predictions are advisory only — no automated maintenance actions until validation period complete
activities.acceptance_criteria: PdM model precision and recall above threshold on live data; false positive rate within tolerance

activities.activity: Closed-loop control safe-state fallback validation
prerequisites: Closed-loop control model deployed with edge inference
PLC/DCS integration validated in staging
activities.procedure_required: Inject model failure scenario (bad input, timeout, confidence drop) and verify safe-state fallback to pre-model control logic
activities.safety_hold_point: CRITICAL: safe-state fallback timeout must be < 1 control cycle; validated with production safety team before proceeding
activities.acceptance_criteria: All failure modes tested; safe-state fallback activates within 1 control cycle; operator notified immediately

activities.activity: MLOps pipeline validation (training → registry → edge deployment → monitoring)
prerequisites: MLOps platform deployed and configured
At least one production model in registry
activities.procedure_required: Run model retraining → push to registry → deploy new version to edge → verify monitoring catches drift
activities.safety_hold_point: Model replacement on edge must not interrupt running inference (blue-green or canary deployment)
activities.acceptance_criteria: Full MLOps pipeline executes end-to-end in < 4 hours; model rollback tested; monitoring alerts on drift detected

activities.activity: Control tower and alerting system UAT with operations
prerequisites: All dashboards deployed and data flowing
Alert rules configured in monitoring system
activities.procedure_required: Operations team walks through all dashboards and alert scenarios; UAT sign-off per role (operator, supervisor, plant manager)
activities.acceptance_criteria: UAT signed off by operations team; alert fatigue risk documented and mitigated; escalation path working

activities.activity: OT cybersecurity pen test and zone validation
prerequisites: Network segmentation implemented per solution architecture
All edge devices and OT appliances connected
activities.procedure_required: External pen test (production impact must be coordinated and scheduled in a maintenance window)
activities.safety_hold_point: Pen test must be approved by OT change control; backout plan prepared
activities.acceptance_criteria: No critical or high-severity findings in OT zones; medium/low findings documented with remediation plan

activities.activity: Role-based training delivery across all user personas
prerequisites: All dashboards and tools deployed
Training materials (user guides, SOPs, quick reference cards) prepared
activities.procedure_required: Deliver role-based training sessions: operators (dashboard, alerts), supervisors (control tower, reporting), plant managers (KPI review), maintenance (PdM workflow)
activities.acceptance_criteria: Training completion register signed per role; post-training confidence survey > 80% positive

activities.activity: Operations and maintenance SOP handover
prerequisites: All SOPs drafted and reviewed with operations and maintenance teams
activities.procedure_required: Formal handover of SOP binders/digital library to operations and maintenance managers; 2-week shadow support by SI
activities.acceptance_criteria: SOPs signed off by operations and maintenance heads; shadow-support schedule agreed

activities.activity: Continuous improvement framework and quarterly ROI review cadence establishment
prerequisites: Baseline and post-deployment metrics available
ROI model updated with realized gains
activities.procedure_required: Establish continuous improvement governance: monthly KPI review, quarterly ROI assessment, annual program review
activities.acceptance_criteria: CI charter signed; quarterly review dates scheduled; benefits tracker operational

activities.activity: Scale-out roadmap and replication pattern documentation
prerequisites: Pilot complete with validated results
Lessons learned captured
activities.procedure_required: Document the replication pattern: architecture, procurement specs, deployment procedure, cost template, risk register update, and lessons learned for each remaining line/site
activities.acceptance_criteria: Scale-out roadmap approved by steering committee; replication pattern document delivered
